name: Em Cabin Pro (V1)
description: LIGHTWEIGHT & UNBREAKABLECrafted with a polycarbonate hard shell that makes it incredibly durable. FRONT QUICK ACCESS COMPARTMENTA front compartment which gives you quick access to your tech, while you’re at the security checkpoint. Fits up to a 15.6” laptop, a laptop charger and documents. SUPER SILENT NINJA WHEELS 8 silent-run Japanese Hinomoto wheels that glide like butter across both carpeted floors and tiled surfaces.TSA-APPROVED LOCK Keyless TSA Lock security. This lock does not require a key for you to unlock. Simply push the latch towards the numbers to unlock. Instructions to set your lock code will be inside the luggage.DIMENSIONS, WEIGHT and CAPACITY56 x 35.6 x 25 cm, Weight: 3.29 Kg, Capacity: 41 L

mainEntity.name: What size laptop fits in the front compartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The front compartment fits a laptop up to 15.6 inches, along with a laptop charger and documents.

mainEntity.name: How does the TSA lock work?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is keyless. Push the latch towards the numbers to unlock, and set your lock code using the instructions inside the luggage.

mainEntity.name: How much does the bag weigh and how much can it hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Em Cabin Pro weighs 3.29 kg and has a capacity of 41 L.
